title: perf(console): write app navigation at page and dashboard create and delete sites
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNiiAtyW6uY3eTDyWYkBLff)_

Fixes #28680
Fixes #28645

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:页面或仪表盘在控制台被创建(首次发布)或删除时,由该处直接写入应用导航;`NavigationSyncEffect` 不再在每个应用页读取整张 `/meta/page` 和 `/meta/dashboard` 列表做差异比较。
- 为什么改:这是 #28645 的第二步,按维护者裁定 A(#28680)。去掉这两次列表读取后,页面路由 26 → 24 次请求,对象列表路由 33 → 31。
- 风险与回滚:在本标签页之外创建或删除的无包页面/仪表盘(服务端智能体、另一个标签页、直接调用 REST)不再自动进入导航,只能由其写入方处理;包安装和 CLI 部署的条目带 `_packageId`,原本就不经过差异比较。回滚即还原本 PR,无数据或协议变更。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavigationSync.ts`(`useNavigationWrites`)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`(`doPublish`、`runReset`)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.navigationWrites-28680.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useNavigationSync.test.tsx`,预期 22 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。仪表盘路由仍读 `/meta/dashboard`(见 Deviations),可另开卡处理。

## What changes

`NavigationSyncEffect` read the whole `/meta/page` and `/meta/dashboard` lists on every app page, after the first paint, only to diff their name sets and add or remove navigation entries. Maintainer ruling A on #28680 retires it. The console's sites now write navigation themselves, through a new door in `useNavigationSync.ts`:

- **`useNavigationWrites()`** returns `created(type, name, item?)` and `deleted(type, name, item?)`. They call the existing `sync…CreatedAllApps` / `sync…DeletedAllApps` writers and keep the diff's rules: only a `page` or a `dashboard`; never a platform artifact (`isPlatformArtifact`: a `sys_` name, or `_packageId` / `_provenance: 'package'`); nothing in draft preview (ADR-0037, where `apps` may be draft bodies); only into apps that may be written (`isNavigationSyncableApp`). Entries are written label-less, as before (objectui#9868).
- **The metadata editor's Publish** (`ResourceEditPage` `doPublish`): when the item held no layer before the publish (its draft was its only layer, `/layers` 404) and the editor is not bound to a package, the page or dashboard is created and joins navigation. A later publish of the same item is an update and writes nothing.
- **The metadata editor's Delete** (`runReset` with no baseline): an unbound real delete removes the item from navigation. A reset to a packaged baseline writes nothing.
- **Publish all** (`usePublishAllDrafts`): before publishing each package-less page or dashboard draft, it asks the item's layers. The ones that had none are created and join navigation after the batch. A failed layers read is not taken for a create.
- **A create no longer duplicates an entry.** `syncPageCreated` / `syncDashboardCreated` skip an app whose navigation already references the target at any depth (`navigationReferences`). `addNavigationItem` itself still appends.
- **`NavigationSyncEffect`** stays exported, `@deprecated`, and renders nothing. `AppContent` no longer mounts it.

No rename site exists in the console today, so the `sync…RenamedAllApps` writers keep no caller.

### Who relied on the diff (the claim's pre-code check)

Nothing created outside the console. The diff dropped every platform artifact, and package installs and CLI deploys carry `_packageId` (checked on the running showcase: `showcase_start_here`'s layers answer `_packageId: 'com.example.showcase'`, `_provenance: 'package'`). Studio always saves with a package. The diff acted only on package-less pages or dashboards that appeared or vanished in this tab's lists mid-session, and its baseline re-seeded on every load.

**What no longer reaches navigation:** a package-less page or dashboard created or deleted outside this tab (a server-side agent, another tab, a raw REST call). It now reaches navigation only through its own writer. The changeset says the same.

## Tests

- New `ResourceEditPage.navigationWrites-28680.test.tsx` (5 cases, the real page): the first publish adds the page to the app once and a **second publish adds no second entry**; publishing an item that already had a layer writes nothing; a package-bound publish writes nothing; a real delete removes the entry; a reset leaves navigation alone.
- New `usePublishAllDrafts.navigationWrites-28680.test.tsx` (2 cases, real `MetadataClient`): new package-less page and dashboard join; an updated page, a packaged page and a flow do not; layers are asked before each publish; a failed layers read writes nothing.
- `useNavigationSync.test.tsx`: the diff's cases are replaced by `useNavigationWrites` cases (platform artifacts in both directions, other types, draft preview, locked apps, a second create of a referenced page or dashboard), `navigationReferences`, and a pin that `NavigationSyncEffect` reads neither list and writes nothing.
- `labelInherits-9868`, `standardEntryLocalizes-11201` and `chromeReads.afterFirstPaint-12980` now drive the new door, or pin that the retired effect reads nothing.
- Ablations, each one red: always-first-publish, publish ignoring the package binding, no create write, no delete write, delete on reset too, publish-all without the layers check, publish-all without the write, writer without dedupe, no preview skip, no platform skip, no type filter (11 of 11).

## Acceptance notes

Measured on a production console build (`pnpm build`, `pnpm console:build`, `pnpm dev -- --fresh`), `showcase_app`, admin, API calls of a warm reload, two runs each with the same count:

| Route | Base `2678600d` | PR 1 (#28754) | This PR | Difference from PR 1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page/showcase_start_here` | 26 | 26 | **24** | `/meta/page` −1, `/meta/dashboard` −1 |
| `dashboard/showcase_ops_dashboard` | 35 | 35 | **34** | `/meta/page` −1 |
| `showcase_task` (object list) | 33 | 33 | **31** | `/meta/page` −1, `/meta/dashboard` −1 |

On the running server, a page saved as a draft answers `/layers` 404 and its first publish turns it into a layer with `resettable: false`, which is the editor's create and delete verdict this PR reads. The probe page was deleted afterwards.

Deviations:
- **The dashboard route is 34, not the expected 33.** Its own route gate in `AppContent` waits for the `dashboard` list (`routeReads`), and the dashboard view reads its definition from it. The effect shared that one request, so removing the effect saves only `/meta/page` there. Reading the dashboard route bundle-first, as PR 1 did for the page route, would remove it. That is `AppContent`'s route gate and the dashboard view, outside this claim's surface, so it is left for a follow-up card.
- **Publish all from the draft-preview bar writes no navigation.** The door writes nothing in preview, where `apps` may be draft bodies. The diff wrote nothing there either.
- `AppContent.tsx` changes only to drop the mount. `useNavTargetLabel.ts` keeps a comment that says the console's `NavigationSyncEffect` loads the dashboard list; it is outside the surface and left as it is.
